text:
kim: quick ping — PR #4642 is tiny: rename `userShortID` -> `user_id` + apply gofumpt. CI failed on formatting, need one more LGTM to merge in today's 30m merge window. @alex @sara

alex: thanks — what's the gofumpt failure look like? is it just whitespace or a generated proto change?

kim: it's only formatting and a name tweak in internal pkg/users. no proto changes. pasted failing job output below:

devops-bot: build #1274 — gofumpt check failed:
```
/workspace/pkg/users/identifiers.go:24:6: exported type userShortID should have comment or be unexported
/workspace/pkg/users/identifiers.go:42:1: file is not gofumpted (gofumpt)
```

kim: the first linter nit is from an exported type name that became exported after the rename; added a short comment in the last commit. main blocker was the gofumpt formatting, I ran `gofumpt -w .` locally and pushed. CI shows old result because job started before the push.

sara: can re-run CI and give LGTM once green. @devops-bot can you re-run the job? :pray:

devops-bot: @sara requested a rebuild: triggered build #1275 — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1275

alex: cool. i'm fine approving once CI passes. small ask: add a one-line changelog entry? helps with release notes automation.

kim: added `scripts/changelog/entries/4642.md` with one line: "normalize user id field name for consistency". pushed in the same commit.

sara: build #1275 passed :green_heart: — LGTM from me. :thumbsup:

alex: LGTM as well.

kim: awesome, merging now into main during this slot. leaving a note to squash commit into one. thanks y'all. :tada:

devops-bot: merged PR #4642 into main (kim) — commit 9f2c4a7 — triggered release candidate pipeline.
